log.notes_to_self: Day1 plan: Me=East, blotter, clips(<25), forum, foreign, night worker (free morning+afternoon). Strategy: ALL quick kills in AFTERNOON so routine filter only removes day workers (pool x0.55 -> 55000). Each place kind L traces cuts pool: regional/age/forum/foreign x0.25, sector x0.2. Caught if pool<=1000 at end of any day. 55000*.25*.25=3437 safe; a third 25% kind gives 859 = CAUGHT unless that kind is unreachable by L (2 of 5 kinds unreachable, unknown). L only uses a place after 3 successful traces there; 5 traces/day random from deaths. Day1: killed national + 2 forum + 2 foreign + 2 clips (7). Watch pool: if it drops to ~13750 one kind confirmed, ~3437 two kinds. If two of {forum,foreign,clips} confirmed reachable (pool ~3000), STOP killing the third kind's victims and also avoid East/blotter. If a kind's kills keep happening without pool drop, it's likely unreachable -> safe to use freely. Multiplier needs 30 deaths in last 5 days (6/day avg); 40 for x4.

Each place kind L confirms cuts the pool: regional/age/forum/foreign x0.25, sector x0.2. Caught if pool <=1000 at the end of any day. 55000 x .25 x .25 = 3437 is safe; a third confirmed kind is CAUGHT. L can reach 3 of the 5 kinds, unknown which, so using 3 kinds risks the 3 cuts landing together (about 1 in 10 chance). Day1: 7 kills (national, 2 forum, 2 foreign, 2 clips); after day1 pool 60000, traced 2. Day2: national + 2 forum + 2 foreign only (no clips) to see which kinds trigger. If forum/foreign kills keep being traced with no pool drop, that kind is likely unreachable, so safe to add clips. Multiplier needs 30 deaths in the last 5 days (40 for x4).
